description: An absent common guard removes the private boundary condition before load validation (engine §2.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text X r | Y r
%rule r C ($a:aa ≻ bb) :: ∅ | $c:empty ($a:aa ≻ bb) :: ∅
%conditions $c ⟹ ($a.tags = A ∧ ¬$.preceded-by(X))
%rule aa A
%rule bb A
%rule empty ε
